work_done: Implemented Phase 3 Part A (signed download URLs + local object store + download/tool routes). Created app/signing.py: sign_key(key, expires_at, *, secret=None) and verify(key, expires_at, sig, *, secret=None, now=None) over HMAC-SHA256 of f'{key}:{expires_at}' with hmac.compare_digest, rejecting on any key/exp/sig mismatch and on expires_at < now; signed_download_url(key, *, ttl_seconds=900, secret, base_url, now) building '{base}/download?key=&exp=&sig='. The signing secret and base URL default lazily to settings.url_signing_key / settings.download_base_url (read only at call time, never at import) and are overridable for tests/adapters; no provider SDK imported. Added signed_url(self, key, *, ttl_seconds=900) to the ObjectStore Protocol in app/ports.py and implemented it on GcsObjectStore (delegates to app.signing.signed_download_url, backend /download URL not GCS presign). Created app/providers/local/__init__.py and app/providers/local/storage.py: FsObjectStore (download/upload/exists/delete/signed_url over a configured root, _reject_traversal rejecting '..'/leading-separator/absolute/drive keys plus a resolved-path-inside-root defence) and MinioObjectStore (same ops over the S3 API via a lazily-built minio client, signed_url still through app.signing); both carry an injectable signing_secret/download_base_url and a from_settings classmethod. Extended app/providers/__init__.py get_object_store to return FsObjectStore for provider 'local' and MinioObjectStore for 'minio' ('gcp' unchanged). Added app/auth.py require_tool_token: FastAPI Header dependency comparing Authorization: Bearer to settings.tool_api_token (resolved lazily/tolerantly) with hmac.compare_digest, failing closed (401 on missing/wrong-scheme/wrong/unconfigured token). Wired app/main.py: GET /download parses key/exp/sig, calls signing.verify, 403 on bad/expired, else streams request.app.state.store.download_bytes(key) (404 on FileNotFoundError); POST /tool/retrieve (ToolRetrieveRequest {query, prefer_courses?}) guarded by require_tool_token, calls retrieval.answer_query and returns the matched paper metadata plus store.signed_url(served_object_key or object_key). Added tests/test_signing.py (accept-fresh / reject expired/tampered-sig/tampered-key/tampered-exp/wrong-secret, URL round-trip) and tests/test_fs_objectstore.py (isinstance(ObjectStore), upload/download/exists/delete round-trip in tmp_path, traversal/absolute keys raise on download and upload, signed_url verifies). Updated the pre-existing tests/test_ports.py for the additive port method: FakeObjectStore gained a signed_url method, and test_factory_unknown_provider_raises now uses provider 'bogus' (since 'local'/'minio' object stores are now valid). Verified: python -m pytest tests/test_ports.py tests/test_signing.py tests/test_fs_objectstore.py -> 23 passed; app.main imports cleanly and registers /download and /tool/retrieve. Note the sandbox runs Python 3.14 (project targets 3.12); the Part A tests are config-independent and pass, but the full suite was not run here per the known 3.14 conftest/db_session limitation.
